text:
maya: Quick thought for next webinar: instead of one big credit drop, run an "unlock ladder" where users complete tiny milestones (view prompt demo, run starter template, submit one output) to earn incremental unlocks. Goal = faster time-to-first-success and higher template re-use. What do folks think? :sparkles:

luis: Nice. Need 2 clarifications: what's the control arm, and how do we keep post-webinar signups in the same ladder sequence?

maya: Control = our usual 100 starter credits delivered in one batch. Ladder experiment = 4 steps: 20 on join, 30 after demo run, 30 after completing guided template, 20 bonus for sharing output. Use a registration query param (?flow=ladder2026) so signups are auto-tagged and routed into the same timed sequence.

nicole: Can we cap experiment to first 800 seats and then expand? Also propose an in-webinar micro lab (2min) — 3 clicks to complete — to reduce friction for the demo run milestone.

ryan: For tracking, event names: ladder_joined, demo_ran, template_completed, output_shared, credits_redeemed. Add user_prop: flow_version. We'll need ingestion on analytics to mark cohort immediately. Sam, can growth create a shortlink?

sam: Yep. I'll spin up rdw.in/ladder2026 and pass to webinar CTAs. Also will add GA/UTM: utm_source=webinar, utm_campaign=ladder_launch.

analytics-bot: Note: please log expected schema for events. Suggest properties: user_id, experiment_bucket, ts, token_spent_estimate. I'll create a ticket in analytics board.

maya: UX copy ideas for CTAs (short): "Run the quick demo — unlock 30 credits" / "Share an output to get a bonus 20". Nicole, can you draft variations A/B (action vs curiosity framing)?

nicole: On it. I'll do 2x variants and link tests to the join->demo conversion metric.

ryan: Also want a small benchmark narrative snippet for post-mortem: "Ladder test: driving immediate success vs single-drop credits" with baseline KPIs (24h activation, template reuse, 7d retention). Add token-cost per template to avoid surprises (~120 tokens/run).

ops-bot: Routing PR created: https://github.com/redwood/ops/pull/1831. Pseudocode for routing in PR description:
```
if registration.params.flow == "ladder2026":
  tag user.flow = "ladder2026"
  schedule email at t+30m: deliver step1 credits
  schedule in-app prompt after token_creation: show demo CTA
```

sam: Owners & next steps: maya -> run experiment brief and host sync; nicole -> CTA copy + in-webinar micro lab; ryan -> analytics schema + dashboard; luis -> seat cap and sampling; ops -> deploy routing; sam -> shortlink. Sync in 24h to confirm instrumentation.

maya: Success criteria (quick): 1) +12% lift in users with a second session within 24h; 2) +18% template re-use within 72h; 3) support contacts related to credit confusion under 8% of cohort. If we hit targets, plan roll to monthly webinars.

nicole: Also adding an in-session 1-question poll: "Did you get a usable output today?" — helps tie qualitative to activation. Will add to slide deck.

ryan: I'll prototype a tiny dashboard with funnel stages: join -> demo_run -> template_complete -> shared_output -> 24h_active. Will include median tokens/day and cost per activated user.

sam: Experiment created: exp_ladder_2026_397500. Shortlink live. Exported seed list to s3://rdw-growth/exp_ladder_397500/seeds.csv. :rocket:

maya: Great. Quick ask: keep all copy explicit about "how many credits" per action to avoid confusion. Thanks team — morning sync tomorrow 9:30 to confirm analytics + ops PR review. :thumbsup:
